title: Finding Shapes in the Clouds
statementMd:
After eating and settling down on a soft blanket by the lake, Sunny and Aubrey began gazing at the sky. The friends noticed an unusual long band of $n$ clouds, where each cloud is either fluffy and white (represented as "0") or thin and dark (represented as "1"). Let $s$ be the current string of cloud types.

While watching the sky, Aubrey noticed an unusual phenomenon: when gusts of wind blow through the cloud band, a "cloud swirl" occurs.

In one cloud swirl, the friends can choose two clouds at positions $i$ and $j$ ($1 \le i  \lt  j \le |s|$) that have the same type ($s_i = s_j$). As a result of this wind:

1. Both selected clouds $s_i$ and $s_j$ dissipate and completely disappear from the band.
2. All clouds located strictly between them (at positions from $i+1$ to $j-1$) invert their type due to turbulence: a white cloud ("0") becomes dark ("1"), and a dark cloud ("1") becomes white ("0").

The remaining clouds keep their order and are renumbered starting from one.

Can the friends make the cloud band empty by applying this operation?

## Input

Each test consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains an integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$) — the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the initial length of the cloud band.

The second line contains a binary string $s$ of length $n$ consisting only of characters '`0`' and '`1`'.

The sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, print `YES` if the sky can be completely cleared of clouds, and `NO` otherwise.

You can output each letter in any case (for example, `YES`, `Yes`, `yes` will be recognized as a positive answer).

## Note

In the third test case, remove the clouds at positions $1$ and $4$ in `011010`. After the inversion the band reads `0010`. Removing positions $2$ and $4$ now leaves `00`, whose two clouds can disappear together.

In the fourth test case the two clouds have different types, so there is no legal first move.

samples.output:
YES
NO
YES
NO

YES

statementZhMd:
吃饱后，Sunny 和 Aubrey 在湖边一条柔软的毯子上安顿下来，开始仰望天空。两位朋友注意到一条不同寻常的长长云带，其中有 $n$ 朵云，每朵云要么蓬松洁白（用 "0" 表示），要么稀薄暗沉（用 "1" 表示）。设 $s$ 为当前表示云朵类型的字符串。

观赏天空时，Aubrey 注意到了一个奇特的现象：当阵风吹过云带时，会发生一次“云旋涡”。

在一次云旋涡中，两位朋友可以选择位于 $i$ 和 $j$（$1 \le i  \lt  j \le |s|$）且类型相同（$s_i = s_j$）的两朵云。这阵风会产生以下效果：

1. 选中的两朵云 $s_i$ 和 $s_j$ 消散，从云带中完全消失。
2. 严格位于它们之间的所有云朵（即位置从 $i+1$ 到 $j-1$ 的云朵）都会因湍流而改变类型：白云（"0"）变成暗云（"1"），暗云（"1"）变成白云（"0"）。

剩余云朵保持原有顺序，并从一开始重新编号。

两位朋友能否通过执行这一操作，使云带变为空？

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）——测试用例的数量。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$）——云带的初始长度。

第二行包含一个长度为 $n$ 的二进制字符串 $s$，仅由字符 '`0`' 和 '`1`' 组成。

所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，如果能够清空天空中的所有云朵，输出 `YES`，否则输出 `NO`。

输出时，每个字母的大小写均可任意（例如，`YES`、`Yes`、`yes` 都会被识别为肯定回答）。

## 说明

在第三组测试用例中，移除 `011010` 中位于 $1$ 和 $4$ 的云朵。类型翻转后，云带变为 `0010`。接着移除位于 $2$ 和 $4$ 的云朵，剩下 `00`，这两朵云可以一起消失。

在第四组测试用例中，两朵云的类型不同，因此无法进行任何合法的第一步操作。
